name: weighted sum of distance kernels centred on prototypes
mechanism: place centres in the input space, compute for a query a kernel of its distance to each centre, and output a learned weighted sum of those kernel values

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Radial basis function network' in section Computer science / Machine learning and statistical classification: an artificial neural network that uses radial basis functions as activation functions

requires: centres and kernel widths (policy or learned)
fails_when: curse of dimensionality in centre placement
